pages.text: $(bold)Sickle$()$(br)Right-click ripe crops to harvest and replant a $(bold)3x3$() area at once, with Fortune applied; each plant costs 1 durability.
$(bold)Straw Hat$()$(br)Worn on the head, it has a chance to grant $(bold)+1 Fortune$() when you harvest.
$(bold)Harvester$()$(br)A machine that drives along, harvesting and replanting every crop it passes.
